question: Were the two 1998 SEARCA/DENR Calancan Bay reports retrievable from bounded public-source searches, and does an accessible IAMP reference supply fish records?

reportsSought: SEAMEO SEARCA and DENR (1998), Integrated Area Management Plan for Calancan Bay
SEAMEO SEARCA and DENR (1998), Environmental Profile of Calancan Bay
searches: Exact-title web searches across SEARCA, DENR, university and institutional repository records
Review of SEARCA's 2002 monograph record and its accessible third-party text bibliography
Review of the OneOcean coastal-download index for listed Calancan Bay profile or management-plan files
retrieval.interpretation: The reports were not located in this bounded search. This is not evidence that no copy exists in a physical or unindexed archive.

contextSource.title: Proceedings of the Workshop on Achieving the MDGs through Enhancing Local Capacities for Integrated Coastal Resources Management: Evidences and Lessons Learned
contextSource.reviewedEvidence: The proceeding includes a process-framework slide for the Calancan Bay IAMP. It depicts situational analysis (including fisheries and resource/ecological assessment), goal setting, plan preparation, management bodies/zones/strategies and implementation, with public participation. Other slides summarize historical management issues, but they do not reproduce the two original 1998 reports or provide a taxon-by-waterbody fish table.
contextSource.reuse: No item-specific license was verified. Do not copy figures, slides or tables into the app.

integrityFindings.1998EnvironmentalProfile: Not retrieved; fish content, sampling dates, station design, taxa and reuse terms remain unknown.
integrityFindings.1998IntegratedAreaManagementPlan: Not retrieved; the PEMSEA process diagram is contextual evidence about planning workflow, not a substitute for the plan or a fish survey.
integrityFindings.calancanSpeciesUse: No species names, fish occurrences, coordinates, catch values, diet claims, fishing rules or safety conclusions were obtained from this access review.
integrityFindings.projectProgress: The unavailable reports remain archival leads but do not block screening of other independently accessible MIMAROPA sources.

limits: A bounded indexed search cannot establish that a report is absent from all physical, institutional or unindexed collections.
The 2006 workshop proceedings are secondary/context material and are not the two 1998 SEARCA/DENR reports.
The IAMP process framework contains no verified species-by-site data and does not establish current Calancan Bay conditions.
No report-specific reuse permission or open license was identified.

followUp.nextAction: Keep both 1998 reports in the archival-lead queue. Continue with a separately sourced Palawan or Mindoro fish study that provides inspectable taxon-level evidence; retain marine and inland-water evidence as distinct habitat records.
